_comment: The raw properties object of the `permission.asked` bus event opencode 1.18.32 raises for an MCP (host-suite) tool call — the shape an Ask turn's `orchicon_*` tools go through, verified against the real 1.18.32 binary by QA on this work item. Unlike the built-in edit/write/bash ask it carries NO detail of its own: `permission` is the MCP tool KEY, `patterns` is the wildcard RULE, `metadata` is empty. Nothing here can be keyed or shown to a user, which is exactly why the consent core must take the target/command from the tool call's ARGS (internal/opencode toolCallIndex attaches them to Detail as `toolInput` after correlating `tool.callID`), and why an ask that resolves no target and no command FAILS CLOSED to a card instead of proceeding.
